تقتصرين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِرِينَ (taqtaṣirīna) /taq.ta.sˤi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# تُقْتَصَرِينَ (tuqtaṣarīna) /tuq.ta.sˤa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
